synthesis.description: Desks need new trading books in Tagg, Sitara, TDS and RisktRAC when regions are split, new offices such as Chicago open, new counterparties arrive or the Netco books are created. Darron Giron gathers the book names, trader and portfolio details, fills in the book request form and sends it to the set-up team, which asks follow-up questions such as the trader's name and confirms when the book is set up. Lists of book and portfolio codes are circulated, and later Netco book creation and access requests were sent on in bulk.
steps: A desk change, new office or new counterparty creates the need for a book.
The risk analyst gathers book name, trader, portfolio and region and completes the book request form.
The request goes to the set-up team for each system: Tagg, Sitara, TDS or RisktRAC.
The set-up team asks for missing details such as the trader's name.
The analyst follows up on whether the books are complete.
Set-up is confirmed and the book and portfolio code lists are circulated for review.
synthesis.approach: A single book request form that captures every required field up front (book name, trader, portfolio, region, systems) and routes to each system's set-up team, with a status list that shows when each book is live, replacing ad hoc requests and status questions.
synthesis.rationale: The follow-ups in the mail are about missing fields and unknown completion status; a complete request form with a status column addresses both and also serves as the circulated list of book codes.
